featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Kumar Rathor (RJ)
featured_reviews.review_text:
1 Star – Pathetic Experience, Deeply Disappointed
This is one of the worst home-buying experiences I’ve had. I regret trusting the Lodha brand.
I am a buyer in Lodha Woods, and the way buyers are treated here is pathetic and irresponsible.
Possession dates are meaningless.
My agreement mentions 26 December 2025, but after booking, Lodha conveniently hides behind an 18-month grace period. This was never clearly disclosed during sales discussions. The sales pitch creates false confidence, and later the legal fine print is used to escape accountability. Completely misleading.
Zero transparency, zero ownership.
There is no clear explanation for delays, only standard template responses like “project is not delayed as per agreement.” This shows complete disregard for buyers’ time, money, and planning.
Project plan changed at buyers’ expense.
The original plan shown during booking has been altered significantly. More towers and more floors have been added, increasing density and congestion, while open spaces and amenities have been reduced. This directly impacts quality of life. Buyers were sold one vision and are being delivered another.
Amenities & flat delivery NOT as promised.
Amenities were a major selling point, but with plan changes and overcrowding, the actual experience is far from what was committed. The flat and overall project are not being delivered as promised during sales.
Maintenance charges are high and unjustified.
Maintenance is expensive with no transparency on calculation, services, or future escalation. Buyers are expected to blindly accept charges in a project that keeps increasing density and cutting promised spaces.
Post-sales service is terrible.
Once money is paid, buyers are treated like a burden. Responses are generic, slow, and evasive. There is no accountability, no escalation, and no respect for customer concerns.
Emotionally and financially exhausting.
EMIs + rent + uncertainty + broken promises. Buying a home here has been mentally stressful and financially draining.
Final Verdict
Good location, but execution is horrible.
Brand name is being misused.
If you value transparency, trust, and peace of mind — think twice before booking.
This project is a classic example of how big builders get away with buyer-unfriendly practices.

featured_reviews.name: Hanwant Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
I booked a flat in Tower 6 at Lodha Woods in November 2024 with a clear commitment of possession by September 2025. This assurance was reiterated multiple times by Lodha representatives during booking. Today, after paying all dues promptly, I am shocked to learn that possession is now delayed to February 2026, and even further delays are being hinted at.
What’s worse:

1. False promises at the time of booking.
2. No proactive communication on delays.
3. Representatives stopped responding to calls and messages.
4. Extremely prompt when it comes to payment follow-ups, but zero accountability for commitments.
5. Every delay is causing huge financial loss and mental stress.

The customer service is irritating, frustrating, and unprofessional. Lodha claims to be customer-centric, but this experience proves otherwise. I feel cheated and misled.

If you value transparency and timely delivery, think twice before trusting such commitments.
